applies_why: The judge text compares the challenger's and defender's chains by footing and declares the collision underdetermined, so it is doing the chain-against-chain weighing K-C governs.
quote: the challenger's seed/loins chain is footed but does not name Joseph as the begetter
rule_words: A link is judged by its support, never by whether any verse, or the chain as a whole, states it word for word; and a verse whose words leave the question open decides nothing by itself.
room: weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse: read as assessing support versus read as requiring explicit naming.
why: The judge faults a footed chain for not explicitly naming Joseph, which is a word-for-word/stating-verse requirement that K-C retires in chain-against-chain footing.
